verdict.rationale: Homebrew has no separate GUI. Its official CLI is the primary interface, and it is documented as scriptable for automation: non-interactive installs, `--yes`, use in administrative scripts and scheduled jobs, and declarative `brew bundle` workflows for CI. The only HTTP API documented is a read-only JSON listing of formula and cask metadata, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: a documented programmatic API with parity to every CLI operation (the JSON API covers metadata only), a machine-readable API spec, and independent corroboration of automation parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: List the `brew info --json` output for all current Homebrew/homebrew-core formulae or Homebrew/homebrew-cask casks.
Use this in administrative scripts and scheduled jobs to manage an existing installation, including when no user is logged in.
one command can set up project dependencies across these environments and in continuous-integration services such as GitHub Actions.
